entries.2610817494b45a4e: Power Generation and Transmission/Distribution Equipment and Electric Wire
entries.2d0bf49954da76d3: This is the stage of searching for, drilling, producing, and selling oil and natural gas.
entries.39afbab5c3209737: It procures power generation equipment, receiving and transforming equipment, and electric wires and cables for power transmission and distribution.
entries.3f67ae12803f4a4e: This is the field of making power plant equipment, and substation equipment, electric wires, and cables for transmitting electricity. Electric power companies and others are the customers.
entries.5db25b49b9f734b9: This is the stage where the electricity and city gas that have been produced are delivered through power transmission lines, substation equipment and gas pipelines. In electricity, the companies responsible for power transmission and distribution provide a service called "wheeling" (takusō). Retail companies and power generation companies can also use the transmission lines through this service.
entries.610272b93361b97f: This is the field of making power plant equipment, and substation equipment, electric wires, and cables for transmitting electricity.
entries.6dfbae5b2584c114: It procures energy-related equipment such as prime movers and boilers used for power generation, and nuclear power equipment. Electric power companies and others are listed as customers.
entries.7db611af4ff29312: This is the stage of delivering the electricity and city gas that have been produced, through power transmission lines, substation equipment, and gas pipelines.
entries.7e73ab38cadeadbd: It procures power generation equipment, receiving and transforming equipment, and electric wires and cables for power transmission and distribution. Electric power companies are listed as customers.
entries.853a5335e835a8ae: This is the stage of making electricity from hydro, thermal, nuclear, and renewable energy such as wind power.
entries.85aa1f15a3b81201: This is the stage of selling fuel, electricity, and gas to households and companies. Petroleum products are sold through service stations and specialty dealers. Electricity and gas are sold for households and for corporate customers.
entries.8aa38dad076b86ad: The energy industry takes resources such as oil and natural gas, processes them into fuel, or turns them into electricity and gas and delivers them. Oil refiners and wholesalers, electric power companies, and gas companies are at its center. Fuels such as gasoline, as well as electricity and gas, are sold to households and companies.
entries.998596116969f22f: The energy industry takes resources such as oil and natural gas, processes them into fuel, or turns them into electricity and gas and delivers them.
entries.a2b4ebb53a79d824: Transportation companies such as railway companies and airlines are listed as customers of oil refiners and wholesalers.
entries.a4e96cecbab87203: This is the stage of selling fuel, electricity, and gas to households and companies.
entries.b7fb63728d97a945: It procures energy-related equipment such as prime movers and boilers used for power generation, and nuclear power equipment.
entries.b9154350fe0aa7ae: This is the stage of searching for, drilling, producing, and selling oil and natural gas. It takes place both in Japan and overseas. The buyers are oil refiners and wholesalers, electric power companies, city gas suppliers, and others.
entries.c08a5bf3d93d0f48: This is the stage of making electricity from hydro, thermal, nuclear, and renewable energy such as wind power. Electric power companies are at its center. Companies in other industries, such as oil companies, also have power generation businesses. The electricity produced is sold to retail companies, the wholesale electricity trading market, and others.
entries.e711a3a21f2c465b: This is the stage of making petroleum products such as gasoline, kerosene, diesel oil, and heavy oil from crude oil.
entries.ea379047dbc73cb4: This is the stage of making petroleum products such as gasoline, kerosene, diesel oil, and heavy oil from crude oil. Raw materials and products for petrochemicals, as well as lubricants, are also made here.
entries.fe4612b713cd4f93: Manufacture of Petroleum Products and Chemicals
entries.fea7e029c07189fd: It sells city gas to large-volume customers such as manufacturers.
